actions.action: Ratify or reject CR-2026-007 and CR-2026-008 (approved by the review chair only), decide CR-2026-009 to CR-2026-019 (`docs/project/CHANGE_REQUEST_LOG.md`), and ratify or reject the review chair's decisions C-1 to C-24 (SQSO-REV-CDR-002 §4)
actions.criterion: Each CR's CCB decision reads Approved, Approved with conditions or Rejected, dated and signed by the PI; a rejected change is reverted in the documents it touched

actions.action: Accept or reject the Class D reliability estimates (L1/L2/L3 0.75 / 0.61 / 0.51; 0.86 / 0.71 / 0.59 with the reliability programme) and keep or drop the programme (≥ 500 h EM flatsat, ≥ 200 h FM burn-in)
actions.criterion: Decision recorded in RELIABILITY_ANALYSIS §5 and MISSION_SUCCESS_CRITERIA §8; if the programme is dropped, FLATSAT_500H and FM_BURNIN leave the schedule and the estimates revert to the allocation case

actions.action: Name the independent PDR board: a chair and at least two reviewers outside the team covering systems, electrical and RF, and flight software; invitations with the 2027-01-12 date
actions.criterion: Names, affiliations and conflict-of-interest statements in PROJECT_PLAN §6.2; data package to the board by 2026-12-29

actions.action: Engage two PCB layout designers (KiCad, IPC-6012 Class 3) for a 2027-01-12 start; decide whether the layout starts at risk on the PDR package
actions.criterion: Agreements in place for both designers; with one designer the plan has −20 d float (§3)

actions.action: Contracting legal entity named (DP-1)
actions.criterion: An entity able to sign the launch services agreement, cross-waivers, insurance declarations and export agreements

actions.action: NASA DAS: software usage agreement requested by 2026-11-06 and in hand by 2026-12-15; DAS run on the ODAR Draft D cases by 2027-01-08; ODAR Draft E with the DAS output by 2027-01-12, for the early FCC filing (2027-01-19)
actions.criterion: DAS reproduces ODAR Draft D: orbital lifetime ≤ 5 years after the end of the 2-year mission at 485 km and 1.85 kg with P ≥ 0.9 under the conservative solar projection, and re-entry casualty risk ≤ 1:10,000 (NASA-STD-8719.14C). If DAS disagrees, the cap moves by CR to the highest altitude DAS passes, before the contract negotiation starts (2027-02-23)

actions.action: Integrator RFQs to Exolaunch, ISISPACE, SEOPS, D-Orbit and Maverick, each asking for: the mission ICD at the contract; the attenuated EXOpod Nova shock MPE at the CubeSat interface; the dispenser thermal analysis for the assigned flight and slot with the deployment time; the SSCMAN 91-710 and battery failure-tolerance requirements; the coupled-loads approach
actions.criterion: Five RFQs sent with these items; replies logged in `docs/ORBITAL_ACCESS.md`

actions.action: Integrator data with the signed contract: mission ICD, levels, attenuated shock MPE, 91-710 and failure-tolerance requirements
actions.criterion: ICD received; LVR and ETP levels replaced by CR; VI-07 (shock) and EPS-23 (failure tolerance) assessed by 2027-07-14

actions.action: IARU coordination: request on 2027-01-26 after the early FCC filing; letter
actions.criterion: Coordinated downlink and uplink frequencies frozen in BASELINE §7 by CR; with no letter by 2027-05-18 the licensee asks the IARU Satellite Advisor for status and the contract proceeds on the requested windows

actions.action: Telecommand stations: written agreements with at least two stations at least 1,000 km apart, each able to command alone
actions.criterion: Agreements signed; stations named in the early FCC filing and the IARU request; VI-GND-02 site survey of each

actions.action: FCC Space Bureau consultation (D3): requested by 2026-11-15 with the agenda (`docs/regulatory/REGULATORY_ROADMAP.md` Rev D §6): the ITU API path and timing (REG-05), whether an early failure ends the mission (ODA-05), the contact timeouts N and M, and the beacon kept with a failed receiver (REG-11); meeting by 2027-01-05
actions.criterion: Outcome recorded by 2027-01-08, before the early filing (2027-01-19). ODA-05 fallback: if an early failure counts as the end of the mission, the 460–465 km band of BASELINE §3 is adopted by CR before the contract negotiation

actions.action: Dispenser soak (THM-06, THM-07): the integrator's dispenser thermal analysis for the assigned flight and slot, with the deployment time, requested in the RFQ (DA-07) and delivered at the contract
actions.criterion: Pack ≤ +50 °C and ≥ −15 °C at deployment, boards within their non-operating limits (V-THM-5). Fallback if the hot result exceeds +50 °C, in order: a deployment-time limit in the contract from the integrator's transient; a low-absorptance finish on the pack-facing surfaces (THERMAL_ANALYSIS §6.5); integrator pad conditioning (purge or air conditioning until fairing close); if none brings the pack to ≤ +50 °C, the PI decides between a lower storage SOC and the NRCSD backup

actions.action: Export counsel engaged; export memo Rev B (authentication versus encryption; foreign integrators)
actions.criterion: Counsel's written opinion; TAA need decided before the contract negotiation (2027-02-23)

actions.action: Panel vendor RFQ with the body-panel cells offset 1 mm from the hinge edge (wing sweep, MECHANICAL_DESIGN §6.6)
actions.criterion: RFQ states the offset; the vendor confirms before the panel order (2027-01-15) that the 45° sweep clearance is ≥ 0.35 mm with its tolerances

actions.action: Venting analysis of every enclosed volume from the CAD (VI-LV-12): the gross 1U volume, the battery clamp cavity, the pocket behind the heat spreader; the RF shield cans are done (V/A 3.2–9.4 m, SQSO-RF-BRD-001 D)
actions.criterion: Each volume / vent area ≤ 50.8 m (CDS §2.1.9); required holes on the drawings in the PDR package

actions.action: SWE-220: measure the cyclomatic complexity of the safety-critical Rust files with a tool and gate it in CI, or tailor by CR
actions.criterion: Every function in the safety-critical components (SDP §3.2) ≤ 15, or a CR listing each exception with its justification; result in `docs/software/NPR7150_COMPLIANCE_MATRIX.md` item C-4

actions.action: Flexible 2 m AntS tapes in the ADCS Monte Carlo (ADCS_DESIGN §11.5): element mass, stiffness and damping from the ISIS ICD (with AV-V7); flexible-appendage case; EM measurement of the deployed tape's first mode and damping in the EM tests
actions.criterion: With the tape's first mode and a damping ratio no higher than the measured or 0.5 %, the spin about +Y converges and +Y stays within 15° of the Sun for ≥ 90 % of sunlit time; the measured first mode within ± 20 % of the model's, or the Monte Carlo re-run with it

actions.action: Procurement data reviews before the EM order: V-HAR-3 (vendor drawings, gold part numbers), V-HAR-11 (ASTM E595 per part number), EPSB-09 (FM12 interrupting rating against the 209 A prospective short, 60 °C rerating, termination code; SMF24A leakage), JETB-07 (every carrier BOM line on the manufacturer's data sheet)
actions.owner: EPS designer, harness designer, payload lead
actions.criterion: Each data sheet or drawing cited in the BOM "MPN check" column; FM12 interrupting rating ≥ 209 A at ≥ 16.8 VDC and ≥ 5 A at +60 °C; storage drain with the SMF24A's +60 °C leakage ≤ 20 µA; every item without E595 data coded A–E or tested; a failing part changed before the order

actions.action: Drawings before the layout: VI-RFB-12 (AntS RF port, coax plating, attenuation, inner conductor; by 2026-11-13, RF lead; ISIS AntS RFQ with the ICD by 2026-11-06); JETB-06 (NVIDIA DG-10931-001 and TDG-11127-001 through a developer account); JETB-12 (Molex drawings)
actions.criterion: VI-RFB-12 pass before the RF layout (2027-02-16); V-JET-2 passes before the carrier layout (2027-03-16); J1 mated height ≤ 13.2 mm and J2 ≤ 7.7 mm from the drawings, else the right-angle J1 fallback

actions.action: Ratify the proposed wordings TBR-MRD-002 to -005 and TBR-SYS-002 to -004
actions.criterion: Each TBR closed in its document (ratified, amended or rejected)

actions.action: Shock (VV-07): decide VI-07 from the integrator's attenuated shock MPE
actions.criterion: Analysis passes only if the vibration-equivalent SRS (24 / 53 / 85 / 60 g at 100 / 500 / 1000 / 2000 Hz) envelops the MPE below 2000 Hz; otherwise an EM shock test at MPE + 3 dB, 2 actuations per axis, in the EM tests (costed in `software/simulation/cdr/pm/test_cost.py`)

actions.action: Ratify the board firmware languages: RF board TNC in Rust `no_std` with the OBC's pinned toolchain (proposed, SQSO-SRS-TNC-001 §7); EPS controller in C11 to MISRA C:2012 with TI MSP430-GCC (recommended, SQSO-SRS-EPSC-001 §7)
actions.criterion: Decision recorded in SMART-QSO-SDP-001 §3.4 and each specification's §7 before the firmware designs go into the PDR package; if Rust is chosen for the EPS controller, a CR with the nightly toolchain and its qualification plan (CR-2026-004 covers only the pinned stable toolchain)
